channel.title: The Catholic Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Catholic Review (catholicreview.org)

item.title: SSPX leader to meet Cardinal Fernández after announcing unauthorized bishop consecrations
item.description: The head of the Society of St. Pius X will meet with Cardinal Víctor Manuel Fernández, the prefect of the Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith, Feb. 12 after the traditionalist group announced plans to consecrate bishops without papal approval, raising fears of a renewed schism.

item.title: Pope Leo denounces human trafficking as a ‘crime against humanity’
item.description: Ahead of the 12th World Day of Prayer and Awareness against Human Trafficking, Pope Leo XIV has condemned the scourge of modern slavery, which has taken even more disturbing forms in our online societies.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV meets leaders of chastity apostolate for Catholics with same-sex attractions
item.description: ope Leo XIV met Feb. 6 with leaders of Courage International, a Catholic apostolate that provides spiritual support to people with same-sex attraction who seek to live chaste lives in accordance with Church teaching.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV urges Christian formators to learn from ‘spiritual giants’ like Augustine
item.description: Pope Leo XIV urged Christian leaders on Feb. 6 to look to the examples of "spiritual giants" including Ss. Philip Neri, Ignatius of Loyola and Augustine as models for faith formation.

item.title: Catholic Charities strengthens Fugett Center offerings with partnerships
item.description: Catholic Charities of Baltimore announced Feb. 2 that it has expanded its community outreach partnerships at the Carolyn E. Fugett Intergenerational Center, which is set to open this spring in West Baltimore.

item.title: Two major medical groups back limits on gender transition procedures for minors
item.description: Two major medical groups have backed limitations on certain types of medical or surgical gender reassignment procedures for minors who identify as transgender.

item.title: Peruvians wait for potential papal visit with anticipation and joy
item.description: Peruvians reacted with a mix of joy and anticipation after Church leaders said there is an "80 percent chance" Pope Leo XIV will visit Peru later this year, likely between November and early December.

item.title: Historic restoration to begin at Bethlehem’s Church of the Nativity Grotto After 600 years
item.description: Restoration is set to begin at the grotto of the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem for the first time in 600 years.

item.title: Sister Thea Bowman’s sainthood moving forward to Vatican review
item.description: Servant of God Thea Bowman's canonization cause is moving ahead, with a Mass and ceremony marking the closure of the cause's diocesan phase to be held Feb. 9 at the Cathedral of St. Peter the Apostle in Jackson, Miss.

item.title: New musical on life of St. Bernadette, Lourdes visionary, begins US tour in Chicago
item.description: Following a successful tour in Europe, a newly developed English version of a French musical about Bernadette Soubirous will open in Chicago Feb. 19 before touring nationwide.
